title: Master CSS 'hyphens' for Enhanced Readability & Polished UI Text Layouts
tweet: Improve web text readability & UI aesthetics! Learn how CSS 'hyphens' automatically breaks words, reducing awkward gaps & creating a cleaner, more professional user experience. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: When working with justified text or narrow columns, CSS 'hyphens: auto;' can dramatically improve visual balance and readability by allowing words to break gracefully. Ensure your <html/> element has a correct 'lang' attribute (e.g., <html lang="en">) for the browser to apply the appropriate language-specific hyphenation dictionaries.
